notes: Sixteen source and twenty-four target tokens each partitioned once; fifteen units, since לִפְנֵי fuses.
לִפְנֵי → before meets rule 30's one-English-word and contiguity conditions, headed on פָּנֶה, which carries the lexeme.
חַמָּן → sun images and חָלָל → slain men both head on the lexeme-bearing word under rule 31, since images and men alone name anything.
cast down keeps its head on the verb: down is a phrasal particle, not a rule 44 complement.
